name: Scope definition and acceptance
purpose: Bound the change and make completion observable before implementation starts.
trigger: Requirements are understood well enough to propose a bounded change.
prerequisites: Requirements or the existing behaviour to change are recorded.

steps.action: Separate in-scope work from explicit non-goals.
Define observable acceptance conditions and negative cases.
Present material product-scope changes to the owner for explicit approval.

outputs: Approved decision record when scope changes

approvals.reason: A material scope change needs owner approval.

recovery: If scope is ambiguous, do not implement the broadest interpretation; ask the owner.
If approval is denied, retain the previous scope and record the decision.
